This application coming on for admission this day, the c
 following:
 Order

1 . This is a bail application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. on behalf of applicant, who is in jail since 27.12.2022 in connection with Crime No.443/2022, registered at Police Station Mandideep District Raisen for the offence punishable under Sections 376, 376(d), 34 (2) of IPC.
2 .
Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that false report has been lodged against the applicants as there was monetary dispute between applicants and Om Prakash Ahirwar.
Prosecutrix as well as her mother have given affidavit to said effect.

In these circumstances,
applicants may be enlarged on bail.

sentences.text: Counsel appearing for the objector submitted that affidavit has already been filed and applicants are innocent and being falsely implicated in the case on basis of complaint made by Om Prakash.
He does not have any objection if applicant are released on bail.

4 . Learned counsel appearing for the State has opposed the application for grant of bail and submitted that in MLC fresh tear marks are seen over the private part of prosecutrix which reflect rape has been committed on her.
In these circumstances, applicant may not be enlarged on bail.

5. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
6.

Considering the no objection given by counsel for the prosecutrix and also taking into consideration the fact that affidavit has already been filed which shows that applicants have been falsely implicated in the case
, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.
Prosecution is at liberty to take action against prosecutrix on the basis of her affidavit in accordance with law.

7. It is directed that the applicants shall be released on bail on their furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) each with one solvent surety each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court.

8. In addition to aforesaid condition, the applicants shall abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
Certified copy as per rules.

(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE DUBEY/-
